root_cause.earliest_faulty_artifact: the corrected-node request exposes correction IDs, action codes and authority aliases but omits each finding code, path and required closure semantics
evidence: the Supervisor saw the full visible finding rows and produced a valid v1.1 plan
the corrected U3 and U4 requests exposed DELL-CORR-023/024 but not the explicit_counterevidence_surface_empty meaning
U3 returned an empty counterevidence_ids array and still passed the generic specialist validator, proving that assigned correction closure was not checked
U4 also left counterevidence_ids empty and regenerated an unsupported approximately 5 percent margin in judgment
the model-visible numeric semantics explicitly limited hypothetical thresholds to what_would_change, while U4 repeated threshold values in financial_or_valuation_link
root_cause.impact: R2 is a valid failed supervised-recoverability measurement, but it cannot isolate model recoverability because the shared project correction protocol does not communicate or verify correction objectives.
root_cause.required_fix: compile typed correction objectives with code path and closure rule into every corrected-node request; verify every assigned correction as closed or typed-unresolved before accepting a node; prevent full-node regeneration from reopening previously closed material numeric failures by restricting financial numeric prose to bound aliases and local deterministic rendering

known_boundary: R2 proves SupervisorPlan v1.1 live compliance and exact-once failure preservation. It does not prove corrected-candidate quality, supervised recoverability, MU/NVDA behavior, product acceptance or release.
